description: This file defines the FirstSpeechUserMuteStrategy class, which implements a user mute strategy to mute user input only during the bot's first speech. It manages state related to whether the bot is speaking and whether the first speech has been handled, reacting to frames indicating when the bot starts and stops speaking.

classes.name: FirstSpeechUserMuteStrategy
classes.description: Implements a mute strategy that only mutes user input during the bot's first speech, allowing early user input but preventing interruptions during initial bot responses.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the strikegy, setting internal state to track if the bot is speaking and if the first speech has been handled.

methods.name: reset(self)
methods.description: Resets internal state to initial values, clearing flags related to bot speech and first speech handling.

methods.name: bool process_frame(self, frame: Frame)
methods.description: Processes incoming frames to decide whether the user should be muted based on whether the bot is speaking and if the first speech has been completed.

methods.name: _handle_bot_started_speaking(self, frame: BotStartedSpeakingFrame)
methods.description: Handles the event when the bot starts speaking by updating internal state.

methods.name: _handle_bot_stopped_speaking(self, frame: BotStoppedSpeakingFrame)
methods.description: Handles the event when the bot stops speaking; marks the first speech as handled if applicable.

ctags.name: process_frame
ctags.pattern: /^    async def process_frame(self, frame: Frame) -> bool:$/
